name: Mumbai
tagline: The city that never quite sleeps.
description: Salt air, late trains, and a skyline that keeps rearranging itself. Mumbai rewards the walker and the early riser.

name: Delhi
tagline: Layers of history, side by side.
description: Mughal stone, wide avenues, and the best chai stops in between. Delhi is a city best read one neighbourhood at a time.

name: Goa
description: Palm shade, long lunches, and a coastline with two very different moods. The north hums; the south exhales.

name: Bengaluru
description: Cool mornings, courtyard cafes, and traffic that rewards patience. Bengaluru keeps its green edges if you know where to look.

name: Kochi
description: Chinese nets, spice warehouses, and ferries that double as commutes. Kochi wears its trading history lightly.

name: Udaipur
description: Palace light on water and rooftops made for slow evenings. Udaipur is at its best just before the day cools.

name: Jaipur
description: Bazaars, block prints, and forts that hold the afternoon heat. Start early, pause for lunch, and go back out for the evening.

name: Chennai
description: Filter coffee, long beaches, and a cultural calendar that never really stops. Chennai is a city of routines worth borrowing.

name: Hyderabad
description: Biryani trails, pearl markets, and a tech district with its own rhythm. The old city and the new one trade glances across the Musi.

name: Kolkata
airport: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport
tagline: Conversation as a way of life.
description: Tram bells, bookshops, and adda that stretches past dinner. Kolkata is generous with its time and its sweets.

name: Pune
description: Fort mornings, bakery afternoons, and a very serious coffee habit. The Sahyadris are always a short drive away.

name: Leh
description: High passes, monastery bells, and skies that refuse to end. Give yourself a day to adjust before the long drives.

name: Varanasi
description: Ghats at dawn, silk in the lanes, and a city that faces the water. The best hours are the ones before breakfast.

name: Amritsar
airport: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport
description: Golden light, langar kitchens, and streets that feed you twice. Come hungry and leave with a longer list.

name: Thiruvananthapuram
tagline: The quiet edge of the peninsula.
description: Temple mornings, red laterite, and a sea that stays close. The backwaters begin just beyond the city.

name: Chandigarh
description: Concrete modernism, rose gardens, and easy access to the hills. A useful base for a longer northern loop.
